_meta.purpose: Stage 5 crowd pacing (Fix A from docs/design/data-drafts/crowd-pacing.draft.json). Population is governed by the SPAWN INTERVAL, not by maxCrowd: steady state = mean route duration / spawn interval, and the shipped numbers held 0.3-1.1 members on screen against a benchmark asking for 2-5.
_meta.whyNotInLocationFiles: src/data/locations/*.location.json is regenerated by the plate compositor, which resets crowd.maxCrowd to its own layout-derived value and has already dropped these numbers twice. LocationData applies this file over the location file at load.
_meta.caps: The quality ceiling lives in visualProfile.maxCrowdSize and is SHARED with the fauna layer; CrowdSystem takes it minus faunaBudget so a full street still leaves the animals room.
_meta.fields: maxCrowd = plate-wide ceiling. density = spawn rate multiplier (interval is 3000/density ms). addCrowdTypes = crowd types appended to the location file s list.

a-famosa-gate.note: A customs gate with only Portuguese and Malay through it is the one place in Melaka where the cargo of four cultures physically has to pass.

st-pauls-church.note: Deliberately quiet. 2 on screen is the target, not 5.
